candidates.name: Invoke-WebRequest
verified_facts: Invoke-WebRequest sends HTTP or HTTPS requests and returns a response object
Connection and operation timeout parameters can bound network diagnostics
semantic_limits: A successful HTTP response does not prove Git authentication, repository write permission, or runner execution

candidates.name: Invoke-RestMethod
verified_facts: Invoke-RestMethod sends HTTP or HTTPS requests to REST services
PowerShell can expose status-code and response-header variables and deserialize JSON responses
semantic_limits: Deserialized remote data must still be checked for expected schema, identity, freshness, and authorization context

candidates.name: Get-NetRoute
verified_facts: Get-NetRoute reads IP route information from the routing table
Route output includes destination prefixes, next hops, and route metrics
semantic_limits: A route entry does not prove end-to-end reachability, TLS success, or application authorization

candidates.name: Get-NetIPConfiguration
verified_facts: Get-NetIPConfiguration reads usable interfaces, IP addresses, and DNS servers
The All switch includes virtual, loopback, and disconnected interfaces
semantic_limits: Configuration readback is supporting evidence and does not prove current traffic flow or GitHub access

candidates.name: Get-NetFirewallProfile
verified_facts: Get-NetFirewallProfile displays configured Domain, Private, and Public firewall profile settings
The ActiveStore can be queried for effective profile conditions
semantic_limits: Profile settings alone do not identify the exact rule or external service causing a connection failure

candidates.name: Get-DnsClientCache
verified_facts: Get-DnsClientCache retrieves the local DNS client cache
Entries can expose names, record types, statuses, TTL values, and cached data
semantic_limits: A cached entry can be stale or negative and does not replace a fresh authoritative DNS query

candidates.name: Get-NetConnectionProfile
verified_facts: Get-NetConnectionProfile reads connection profiles associated with physical network adapters
Profiles expose network category and IPv4 or IPv6 connectivity context
semantic_limits: A connected profile does not prove a specific endpoint is reachable or authenticated

candidates.name: Get-NetAdapter
verified_facts: Get-NetAdapter retrieves basic network adapter properties
Visible, hidden, or physical adapters can be enumerated explicitly
semantic_limits: Adapter presence and link state do not prove DNS, routing, TLS, HTTP, or Git operations succeed

candidates.name: New-TemporaryFile
verified_facts: New-TemporaryFile creates an empty temporary file and returns a FileInfo object
On Windows the temporary folder is selected from documented environment-variable precedence
semantic_limits: Creation in the system TEMP directory does not guarantee the same filesystem or atomic replacement at the final receipt path

candidates.name: Move-Item
verified_facts: Move-Item moves an item and its properties and contents to another location
LiteralPath provides exact path handling and destination collisions raise errors unless Force is used
semantic_limits: The documentation does not promise crash-safe or cross-filesystem atomic replacement; staged files must be on the intended filesystem and read back after the move

candidates.name: Wait-Process
verified_facts: Wait-Process waits for specified local processes to stop
A timeout can bound the wait and the cmdlet can target a PID
semantic_limits: Process exit does not prove cleanup, successful receipt production, or descendant-process termination

candidates.name: Start-Process
verified_facts: Start-Process starts a local process using the System.Diagnostics.Process start method
The Wait parameter waits for the process tree to exit before returning
semantic_limits: Launching a process is not proof that it acquired the canonical runner lock, produced valid receipts, or pushed results
